hero.heading: Unified Data Management 2.0
hero.description: A unified platform to manage real estate data, project pipelines, and financial planning across Property Operations, Retail Asset Management (RAM), and Non-Operating Surplus Sites (NOSS).

modules.headline: Location
modules.description: Standardize how sites are requested, onboarded, and closed out across all portfolios and organize the data hierarchy.

modules.headline: Planning
modules.description: Plan CAPEX, OPEX, and stewardship activities with shared calendars and approvals that keep every business line aligned.

modules.headline: Portfolio Development
modules.description: See the full picture across sites, leases, and projects to keep footprint and roadmap decisions aligned.

modules.headline: Projects
modules.description: Track transactions, leases, and capital projects together, from evaluation through execution.

modules.headline: Real Estate
modules.description: Manage leases, parcels, and site/building records that make up the physical real estate footprint.

modules.headline: Administration
modules.description: Manage reference data, personas, and system configuration that keep every other module running consistently.
